verdict.rationale: Cognee has session memory: each (user_id, session_id) pair stores an ordered list of recent interactions, `remember(..., session_id=...)` writes to the session cache, and `improve()` at the end of a session bridges it into permanent memory that `recall()` can later query. This gives agents continuity across conversations, but nothing in the evidence shows explicit session or thread summaries. Missing for 10: explicit session/thread summarization capability, documented resume-from-prior-session workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
